name: Civil unrest
value: Rawalakot deaths 5 Nov; no new nationwide unrest
summary: Deaths reported after a 5 Nov crackdown on protest camps in Rawalakot, Pakistani Kashmir; no nationwide unrest found
state: Protest leaders in Rawalakot, Pakistan-administered Kashmir, reported three deaths and 18 injured after security forces cleared protest camps on 5 Nov (Kashmir Times); other reports put the toll at seven, and authorities have not confirmed deaths (Outlook India). Searches on 11 Nov found no newer deadly unrest and no nationwide crackdown in a major country, so the status stays at Watch.
for_you: FCDO travel advice for Pakistan and France advises avoiding demonstrations. Unrest tends to disrupt roads and communications locally.
rubric_hit: Watch: deadly unrest in one country (Rawalakot, 5 Nov); not nationwide (Alert line)

sources.title: Kashmir Times — 3 dead, 18 injured as forces crack down on Rawalakot protests
Outlook India — Fresh crackdown in PoK leaves 7 dead, 23 injured

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
